firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently visited a castle is the first player.
clarifications: For starting Castle tiles, players choose in reverse turn order, beginning with the player seated to the first player's right. Gameplay turns proceed clockwise.

sources.title: 890 Anno Domini — GateOnGames English rulebook, version 3
